chunks: Those who believe in God and His apostles—they are the true ones and the martyrs with their Lord; for them is their reward and their light. And those who disbelied and denied Our signs—they are the companions of the Hellfire.

key_terms.الشُّهَدَاءُ: The martyrs, witnesses to the truth
key_terms.الصِّدِّيقُونَ: The truthful, those who are steadfast in faith and speech
key_terms.الْجَحِيمِ: The Hellfire, a place of intense heat and punishment
key_terms.بِآيَاتِنَا: Our signs, referring to God's revelations and proofs

ai.seo_question: Who are the Siddiqun and Shuhada according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the elevated spiritual station of the 'Siddiqun' (truthful ones), often associated with the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who embody perfect fidelity to divine revelation. It contrasts their inner light and reward with the 'Ashab al-Jahim' (Companions of the Fire), emphasizing that true belief is validated by consistent action and witness, while rejection leads to eternal separation from divine grace.
